UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,

Plaintiff,  v.  KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6,

Defendants. ____________________________________/

Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR PRIORITY DETERMINATION AND SEQUENCING OF PENDING PROCEEDINGS CONCERNING ECF NO. 96

Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine moves before District Judge Rossie D. Alston, Jr. under Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 1 and 72(a), 28 U.S.C. § 636(b)(1)(A), and the Court’s authority to control the disposition of matters on its docket. This Motion concerns the order of judicial consideration of matters already pending. Plaintiff seeks priority determination of this Motion and an order permitting the assigned magistrate judge, Magistrate Judge William E. Fitzpatrick, to address the Rule 54(b) reconsideration of ECF No. 96 before the District Judge completes review of the overlapping issues. A Memorandum in Support accompanies this Motion under Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1). Plaintiff incorporates it by reference.

I.	THE PENDING PROCEEDINGS

1.	ECF No. 86 requested determination of historical financial-interest facts. ECF No. 86 at 4, 6. ECF No. 96 denied that motion as moot following reassignment. ECF No. 96 at 1.

2.	ECF Nos. 97–99 present Rule 72(a) objections and related requests to the District Judge concerning ECF No. 96.

3.	Plaintiff’s Rule 54(b) Motion to Vacate ECF No. 96 and Determine Magistrate Judge Davis’s Ownership of Meta Common Stock (the “Rule 54(b) Motion”), filed November 1, 2026, requests restoration and determination of the historical ownership issues as to the dates on which ECF Nos. 64 and 84 were entered. Rule 54(b) Mot. ¶¶ 10, 17, 20.

4.	ECF No. 93 requests retrospective relief concerning ECF Nos. 64 and 84. ECF No. 93 ¶¶ 5, 10(R2). Ordinary briefing on ECF No. 93 was completed through ECF No. 102, filed October 28, 2026.

II.	GROUNDS FOR PRIORITY AND SEQUENCING

5.	The Rule 54(b) Motion seeks determinations concerning facts material to ECF No. 93. ECF No. 93 ¶ 5 lists “the dates of ownership” among “[t]he questions requiring resolution.”

6.	Determination of the Rule 54(b) Motion first would establish what the assigned magistrate judge has decided, declined to decide, or directed for further factual development before district-judge review of the overlapping issues. The “Overlapping ECF No. 96 Issues” are whether ECF No. 96 should be set aside, modified, or given limited effect, ECF No. 97 ¶¶ 7–14, 17–18, 20(4)–(5), and the historical ownership and holding-arrangement facts, with any relief under ECF No. 93 that depends on them, ECF No. 93 ¶¶ 5, 10(R2), 10(R7).

7.	Priority consideration is warranted because ECF No. 93 has completed ordinary briefing and may be adjudicated while the Rule 54(b) Motion remains pending.

III.	RELIEF REQUESTED

8.	Plaintiff requests that this Motion receive priority consideration, be decided on the papers, and receive an express disposition of the sequencing request.

9.	Plaintiff requests an order directing prompt consideration of the Rule 54(b) Motion by the assigned magistrate judge, subject to the District Judge’s determination of the pending referral-authority question. ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R1); ECF No. 97 ¶¶ 15, 20(6).

10.	Plaintiff requests deferral of final district-judge determination of the Overlapping ECF No. 96 Issues until disposition of the Rule 54(b) Motion or further order.

11.	Plaintiff requests that the order preserve immediate determination of independent or threshold issues. Those issues include the successor designation and independently warranted relief under ECF No. 93. ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R6); ECF No. 97 ¶¶ 15, 20(6).

12.	Plaintiff requests that the order preserve all pending objections, motions, existing deadlines, and independent requests for relief.

13.	This Motion does not seek a general stay, supplement ECF No. 93, reopen its briefing, or extend or restart any period to object under Rule 72(a). It does not request deferral of ECF Nos. 10, 21, or 45, and Plaintiff maintains ECF No. 93 ¶ 10(R5)(c).

14.	Plaintiff waives oral argument on this Motion only and requests that the Court direct its submission on the papers under Local Civil Rules 7(E) and 7(J) and Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 78(b). A Notice of Waiver of Oral Argument and Request for Submission on the Papers accompanies this Motion.

15.	Plaintiff relies on the existing docket. No declaration or exhibit accompanies this Motion.

WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court enter the accompanying Proposed Order.

Date: November 1, 2026		                      Respectfully submitted,

Marvelle J. Ballentine

Plaintiff, pro se

1520 Belle View Blvd, Ste. #5847

Alexandria, Virginia 22307

(407) 794-6503

jayballentine@protonmail.com
